About Our College
Welcome to the Tennessee State University College of Engineering — where innovation, creativity, and purpose meet. Whether you dream of building bridges, developing software, designing systems or machines, or exploring artificial intelligence, TSU offers the programs, faculty and community to get you there. Here, you’ll build more than a degree — you’ll build your future. Since 1951, we’ve been building a legacy as one of the nation’s leading producers of diverse engineers, computer scientists, and technologists who are shaping the world one, idea at a time.
Apply
College of EngineeringWhat We Offer
Our programs are designed for the thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who turn bold ideas into real-world solutions. Through innovative curriculum, hands-on experiences, and cutting-edge research opportunities, students gain the knowledge and skills needed to excel in today’s rapidly evolving technological landscape.
Hands-On Learning
Students benefit from experiential learning opportunities that connect classroom concepts with real-world applications. From laboratories and research projects to internships and industry partnerships, our programs emphasize practical experience and professional development.
Career-Focused Education
Our degrees are designed to prepare graduates for success in a wide range of engineering and technology careers. With guidance from expert faculty and access to modern resources, students develop the technical expertise and leadership skills needed to thrive in an ever-changing world.

Graduate Degrees
We offer a range of graduate degree programs designed to prepare students for advanced careers in research, industry, and innovation. Through rigorous coursework, hands-on learning opportunities, and collaborative research experiences, students develop the expertise needed to solve complex challenges and drive technological progress. Whether you are seeking to deepen your technical knowledge, pursue groundbreaking research, or advance into leadership roles, our graduate programs provide the resources, faculty mentorship, and flexible pathways necessary to help you achieve your goals and make a lasting impact in your field.

Departments & Disciplines
Our academic departments provide students with diverse pathways to explore the many facets of engineering, technology, and computing. From designing infrastructure and advancing manufacturing processes to developing software and innovative electrical systems, each discipline offers hands-on learning opportunities and industry-relevant experiences that prepare graduates to lead and innovate in their chosen fields.

Our Vision
To be a premier college of engineering, computer science, and technology that sparks innovation through instruction, research, and service.
Our Mission
We educate and inspire every student to think critically, learn continuously, and lead courageously — contributing to the advancement of their professions, their communities, and the world.
Engineering in Action
Innovation never stops at the College of Engineering. From cutting-edge research and student design competitions to community engagement and industry collaborations, our students and faculty are constantly making an impact both on campus and beyond. Stay connected and discover the latest achievements, breakthroughs, and stories shaping the future of engineering.
